text:
The bug is in `src/cachetools/__init__.py`, within `Cache.__setitem__`.

For new keys, the eviction loop currently uses:

```python
while self.__currsize + diffsize >= maxsize:
```

This evicts an item when the new entry would bring the cache exactly to `maxsize`, causing every cache subclass to hold one entry or one unit of size too few. The update-existing-key path already correctly uses `>`.

I will change the new-key condition from `>=` to `>`, so eviction occurs only when the resulting size exceeds `maxsize`.
